_comment: Copy to clips.json (git-ignored) and list your own test videos for prep.py. Relative paths are resolved against this file's folder. 'start' = first frame used (up to 200 frames are taken); 'fps' is optional (read from the file if omitted). Dataset clips (hf_slowmo_*, hf_timelapse_*) need no entry: prep.py finds them under DATA/All-In-One-Deflicker-Dataset, or under an optional "dataset_root": "path/to/All-In-One-Deflicker-Dataset" here (or DEFLICKER_DATASET).
